# Forks must flatten
Figured out and resolved an ambiguity in how forks behave. Currently, a fork just captures the literal text of the immediate pinned text. If it includes any transcludes, those are included as id markups rather than retrieved and flattened text. After a discussion with Fable, the behavior needed is that forks must flatten everything in the source. We considered the alternative that a pin must require everything it transcludes to also be pinned, but this is both the wrong behavior logically, and obviously mindlessly tedious.
A fork is now a promise to stand behind your content plus the snapshots of any other content you use. Stabilize the referrent without requiring recursive stabilization of everything beyond it.
